# Vendored xterm.js image addon

`xterm-addon-image.js` is a local production build of `@xterm/addon-image`
from [xterm.js PR #6098](https://github.com/xtermjs/xterm.js/pull/6098).

- Commit: `fc43cb00b0ad6fa440bd3c2373b73b3bad0bdcaa`
- Package version: `0.9.0`
- Bundle SHA-256: `f6c1449ff66340af3f6bc60f1afa3c4617a7866d63a95ac9934465aee6adef9e`
- License: MIT (`xterm-addon-image.LICENSE`)

The demo requires that PR's Kitty placement lifecycle fixes. Replace this
vendored build with the upstream npm package after those changes are released.
